name: Deposition of Romulus Augustulus
summary: The Germanic chieftain Odoacer deposes the last Western Roman Emperor Romulus Augustulus (age ~16) and sends the imperial regalia to Constantinople, declaring the Western Empire unnecessary since there is only one emperor. Odoacer rules Italy as king, theoretically under Byzantine suzerainty.

_quarry.structural_significance: Traditional end of the Western Roman Empire and ancient history; in reality the empire had been fragmenting for decades; the Eastern Empire (Byzantium) continues for another millennium.
